parsed.rationale: Both participating records reside in test targets: `Shared/AppServices/Tests/AppServicesTests/NowPlayingServiceTests.swift` and `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift`. Both carry the name `MockArtworkService`, making them mock fixtures used independently by their respective test suites. Even though the Jaccard similarity is 0.75, consolidating these mocks would couple two separate test packages together and risk polluting production or shared code with test-only semantics. The restraint rule requires no-action whenever any participating record is a test fixture, and here both records are.
